say:1:1720833001:1.text: As expected of one of the Order's finest. Your steps are so light even my crows failed to notice.
say:1:1720833001:1.source_cn: 不愧是骑士团中的佼佼者，脚步悄声无息，连乌鸦都未曾察觉呢。

say:4:1720833003:0.text: No one down there wanted to play with me unless I kept things "fair". It took the fun out of it, so I figured I'd bother you instead.
say:4:1720833003:0.source_cn: 楼下那群人一个个的都不乐意和我打，不用青符都不愿意，实...

say:5:1720833004:0.text: Though I didn't expect to find our esteemed mage caught in a rare moment of difficulty.
